data.name: Cheer response
data.description: Thanks the viewer in chat with their message quoted, and reads that message aloud in their own voice. Every step is an ordinary block.

data.name: Raid committed
data.description: Stops the stream, pauses the music, and confirms the raid in chat once Twitch reports the raid as under way. Every step is an ordinary block.

data.name: Raid out
data.description: Starts a Twitch raid, switches OBS to the ending scene, then says goodbye in chat. Every step is an ordinary block — reorder, retime or remove any of it. Stopping the stream, pausing the music and confirming the raid happen separately once Twitch reports the raid as under way (see "Raid committed").

data.name: Raid response
data.description: Welcomes the raiders in chat, says it out loud and shouts out the raider. Every step is an ordinary block.

data.name: Raid starting
data.description: Switches to the ending scene and calls the raid out in chat, once Twitch confirms the raid has started. Every step is an ordinary block.
